svg.title: The merge train
svg.desc: Six steps: approve a PR at a commit, precheck, build the batch, one gate on the merged batch, merge commits, compare the tree of main with the tested tree. A failed gate goes to triage and bisection and back to the build; a failed precheck drops the PR.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the tree of main after the merge is exactly the tree the gate tested
